verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device inference SDK and CLI, so x86 CPU instruction-set acceleration is a fair question for it. However, the evidence only documents acceleration on Qualcomm Hexagon NPUs and Apple Metal GPUs, plus a generic claim of being 'accelerated by whatever silicon the device has'. Nothing mentions AVX, AVX2, AVX512, AMX, or x86 CPU kernels, so this is absence of evidence for an applicable axis.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can leverage advanced x86 CPU instruction sets like AVX, AVX2, AVX512, and AMX for faster inference
